display_name: EU Green Bond Factsheet & Allocation Validator
purpose: Validates an EuGB factsheet (Annex I) + allocation report (Annex II) for completeness and the 100% Taxonomy-aligned proceeds threshold, cross-checking against ART-73 alignment of the funded activities. EuGB Reg. (EU) 2023/2631 applies since 21 Dec 2024; external-reviewer RTS 12 Mar 2026.
